scenes.name: Legal deadline panel

scenes.name: Refund panel

scenes.name: Engagement panel

scenes.name: Heart panel
scenes.whenToUse: When introducing heart rate and cardiovascular health.

scenes.name: Artery panel

scenes.name: Health chart panel
scenes.whenToUse: When illustrating a risk range or an undiagnosed condition. Verify clinical figures before use.

scenes.name: Drink carton panel
scenes.whenToUse: When revealing the sugar content of a packaged drink.

scenes.name: Sugar cubes panel
scenes.whenToUse: When translating grams of sugar into cubes.

scenes.name: Nutrition limit panel
scenes.whenToUse: When comparing sugar with a daily limit and suggesting whole fruit. Verify the intended guidance.

scenes.name: Building panel
scenes.whenToUse: When introducing a property development. The building rises floor by floor while its floor count animates; set floors to zero to hide the count.

name1.summary: Small header line describing the property type.

warning.summary: Upper-corner notice; an empty string hides it.

floors.summary: Floor count displayed while the building rises; zero hides the number without stopping the building animation.

location.summary: Neighborhood or city on the location pin; an empty string hides it.

scenes.name: Location map panel
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining a location and walking distance. The count can land on a spoken word or an explicit panel time; up to two additional locations light up when named.

name1.summary: Small header line describing the property type.

warning.summary: Upper-corner notice; an empty string hides it.

number.summary: Target count in minutes, blocks, meters, or another unit; zero hides it.

unit.summary: Small unit next to the number, such as min or blocks.

fontSize.summary: One or two letters inside the map-point circle.

others.summary: Up to two additional map points separated by |, such as "SCHOOL|MARKET"; each lights up when its name is spoken.

countAt.summary: Spoken word where the count reaches its target, such as "blocks", or a panel time in seconds; empty uses the spoken unit.

scenes.name: Floor plan panel
scenes.whenToUse: When showing a property interior: an outlined floor plan becomes a 3D view with area and four room labels.

name1.summary: Small header line describing the property type.

warning.summary: Upper-corner notice; an empty string hides it.

area.summary: Area in m² counted by the large number; zero hides the number.

rooms.default: SUITE 1|14 m²|SUITE 2|12 m²|LIVING ROOM|28 m²|BALCONY|9 m²
rooms.summary: Four floor-plan labels as name|measurement pairs; an empty measurement keeps the name, and an empty name hides the label.

summary.summary: Top line; the part before the first · is highlighted.

scenes.name: Property price panel
scenes.whenToUse: When introducing a property price above the floor plan. Zero hides the numeric price.

name1.summary: Small header line describing the property type.

warning.summary: Upper-corner notice; an empty string hides it.

value.summary: Price counted on the label in Brazilian reais; zero hides the number.

warningLabel.summary: Lower label line; an empty string hides it.

summary.summary: Top line; the part before the first · is highlighted.

scenes.name: Transition glow
scenes.whenToUse: For a standard scene change: a warm light leak peaks at the cut.

scenes.name: Transition flash
scenes.whenToUse: For a sharp, emphatic cut: a short white flash peaks at the cut.

scenes.name: Transition film burn
scenes.whenToUse: For a change of topic or time: film-burn shapes sweep across the screen.

scenes.name: Transition glitch
scenes.whenToUse: For technology, errors, or sudden reversals: separated color channels, displaced strips, line tearing, and static peak at the cut.

scenes.name: Transition tv
scenes.whenToUse: For a section ending or a joke: the image closes into a line and opens again.

scenes.name: Transition curtain
scenes.whenToUse: For a new item or topic: a strip in the accent color sweeps across the screen.

scenes.name: Transition zoom
scenes.whenToUse: To move toward an important detail: speed rays and blur emphasize the cut.

scenes.name: Transition blinds
scenes.whenToUse: For a change of setting or day: seven strips close and open in sequence.

scenes.name: Transition iris
scenes.whenToUse: To close a story or focus on a detail: a circle closes at the center and reopens.

scenes.name: Transition fade
scenes.whenToUse: For a dramatic pause or passage of time: the image briefly fades to black.

scenes.name: Pointer down arrow
scenes.whenToUse: To point at a button, number, product, or link.

x.summary: Arrow tip on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Arrow tip, in pixels.

size.summary: Arrow height, in pixels.

angle.summary: Rotation around the tip in degrees; zero points down, 90 left, and -90 right.

scenes.name: Pointer curved arrow
scenes.whenToUse: To draw attention to a detail with a hand-drawn curved arrow.

x.summary: Arrow tip on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Arrow tip, in pixels.

size.summary: Arrow width, in pixels.

side.summary: Side from which the arrow arrives: "left" or "right".

scenes.name: Pointer side arrow
scenes.whenToUse: To point toward nearby text, a button, or an on-screen item.

x.summary: Arrow tip on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Arrow tip, in pixels.

size.summary: Arrow length, in pixels.

side.summary: Side of the target occupied by the arrow: "left" points right, "right" points left.

scenes.name: Pointer red cross
scenes.whenToUse: To reject an option or mark something as incorrect.

x.summary: Cross center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Cross center, in pixels.

size.summary: Cross side length, in pixels.

scenes.name: Pointer green check
scenes.whenToUse: To confirm, approve, or mark an item as completed.

x.summary: Check-mark center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Check-mark center, in pixels.

size.summary: Check-mark width, in pixels.

scenes.name: Pointer circle
scenes.whenToUse: To circle a number, face, button, or other detail.

x.summary: Target center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Target center, in pixels.

height.summary: Circle height, in pixels; the final stroke extends about 25 pixels beyond it.

scenes.name: Pointer underline
scenes.whenToUse: To underline an important word, number, or phrase.

x.summary: Underline center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Height of the first underline stroke, in pixels; the second sits about three stroke widths lower.

scenes.name: Pointer box
scenes.whenToUse: To outline a region, screenshot detail, button, or object.

x.summary: Box center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Box center, in pixels.

scenes.name: Pointer highlighter
scenes.whenToUse: To highlight a written phrase, value, or screenshot line.

x.summary: Strip center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Strip center, in pixels.

scenes.name: Pointer spotlight
scenes.whenToUse: To isolate a face, product, or screenshot detail by darkening the surroundings.

x.summary: Lit-area center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Lit-area center, in pixels.

radiusX.summary: Half-width of the lit area, in pixels; the soft edge extends beyond this radius.

radiusY.summary: Half-height of the lit area, in pixels.

darkness.summary: Surrounding darkness from zero, unchanged, to one, black.

scenes.name: Pointer banner
scenes.whenToUse: To conceal an area such as a face, name, number, or screenshot detail.

x.summary: Concealment-bar center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Concealment-bar center, in pixels.

type.summary: "mosaic" pixelates underlying video, "blur" blurs it, and "black" covers it.

cell.summary: Mosaic cell size from 8 to 80 pixels; in blur mode this controls blur strength.

scenes.name: Pointer toggle
scenes.whenToUse: When asking viewers to enable or disable a feature or mode.

x.summary: Button center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Button center, in pixels.

size.summary: Button width, in pixels.

beginsAt.summary: Initial state, "off" or "on"; the toggle ends in the opposite state.

scenes.name: Pointer tap
scenes.whenToUse: When asking viewers to tap or click a specific point.

x.summary: Tap center where the finger touches, on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Tap center, in pixels.

size.summary: Fingertip diameter, in pixels.

taps.summary: Number of taps, distributed across the duration.

scenes.name: Pointer number
scenes.whenToUse: When numbering steps or items over the footage.

x.summary: Dot center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Dot center, in pixels.

size.summary: Dot diameter, in pixels.

number.summary: One to three characters written inside.

textColor.summary: Number color; insufficient contrast falls back to black or white.

scenes.name: Pointer rays
scenes.whenToUse: To surround an important object, face, or number with emphatic rays.

x.summary: Burst center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Burst center, in pixels.

radius.summary: Ring radius from which rays emerge, in pixels; minimum 60.

pulses.summary: Ray bursts during the scene; each needs about 0.3 seconds and excess bursts are clipped.

scenes.name: Pointer question
scenes.whenToUse: When asking a question or showing uncertainty near the speaker's head.

x.summary: Question-mark center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Question-mark center, in pixels.

size.summary: Question-mark height, in pixels.

scenes.name: Pointer exclamation
scenes.whenToUse: When warning about an error, risk, or important precaution.

x.summary: Triangle center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Triangle center, in pixels.

size.summary: Triangle width, in pixels.

scenes.name: Effect vignette
scenes.whenToUse: To create a darker cinematic mood or draw attention to the speaker's face.

size.summary: 0–1: size of the clear center; zero clears only the middle, one darkens only the corners.

x.summary: Clear-area center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Clear-area center near the face, in pixels.

color.summary: Vignette color; black gives a cinematic look.

scenes.name: Effect blur
scenes.whenToUse: To blur the background while keeping the face sharp, like portrait mode.

strength.summary: 0–1: background blur; one gives about a 22-pixel radius.

x.summary: Sharp-area center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Sharp-area center at the face, in pixels.

radiusX.summary: Half-width of the sharp area, in pixels; zero blurs the whole screen.

radiusY.summary: Half-height of the sharp area, in pixels.

scenes.name: Effect glow
scenes.whenToUse: For a dream, memory, luxury mood, or beautiful moment: bright areas gain a soft halo.

warmth.summary: 0–1: shift the halo toward warm gold.

scenes.name: Effect chromatic blur
scenes.whenToUse: For an old-lens, dreamlike, or dizzy look: red and blue fringes appear around edges.

strength.summary: 0–1: red/blue separation; one averages about 14 pixels, from 9 in the center to 21 in corners.

angle.summary: Separation angle in degrees; zero is horizontal, 90 is vertical.

scenes.name: Effect shake
scenes.whenToUse: To emphasize a striking number, reversal, surprise, or impact with camera shake.

strength.summary: 0–1: shake magnitude; one peaks around 26 pixels.

jolts.summary: Number of shakes; zero derives it from duration, approximately one per 0.95 seconds.

scenes.name: Effect money rain
scenes.whenToUse: When discussing sales, profit, revenue, or incoming money.

strength.summary: 0–1: banknote count; one gives about 28 visible notes.

size.summary: Foreground banknote width, in pixels; middle and distant notes are smaller.

scenes.name: Effect confetti
scenes.whenToUse: To celebrate a milestone, sale, achievement, or birthday with confetti.

strength.summary: 0–1: particles per burst; one gives about 90.

x.summary: Horizontal burst origin, in pixels.

y.summary: Vertical burst origin, in pixels.

opening.summary: Burst fan width, from 20 to 170 degrees.

colors.summary: Comma-separated particle colors; accepts hex or named colors and ignores invalid colors.

scenes.name: Effect cinema
scenes.whenToUse: For storytelling, revelations, or epic moments with a film-trailer look.

strength.summary: 0–1: each bar's height; one covers 18% at the top and 18% at the bottom.

mood.summary: 0–1: added contrast between the bars; zero leaves the image unchanged.

scenes.name: Effect noir
scenes.whenToUse: For a serious scene, memory, drama, or secret with a monochrome look.

strength.summary: 0–1: desaturation; 0.5 is partial, 0.8 and above is monochrome with increasing contrast.

contrast.summary: 0–1: black-and-white contrast; one gives a harsh noir look.

scenes.name: Effect tv lines
scenes.whenToUse: For an old CRT, surveillance camera, archival recording, or memory.

thickness.summary: Height of each line, from 2 to 14 pixels.

scroll.summary: 0–1: visibility of the light strip scrolling over the screen.

scenes.name: Effect static
scenes.whenToUse: For a weak signal, interference, failing memory, or suspense.

strength.summary: 0–1: 0.5 resembles a weak signal with the subject visible; one nearly covers the screen.

grain.summary: Grain size from zero, fine, to one, coarse.

color.summary: 0–1: zero gives monochrome static; one gives colored static.

scenes.name: Effect vhs
scenes.whenToUse: For a nostalgic recording, 1990s home video, or archival VHS look.

strength.summary: 0–1: tape look, including bleeding colors, softness, washed-out color, and noise.

bleed.summary: Color-channel offset at full strength, from 0 to 40 pixels.

track.summary: 0–1: visibility of the bottom noise strip; zero hides it.

scenes.name: Effect prism
scenes.whenToUse: For dreams, dizziness, amazement, or confusion: prism-like image copies spread apart.

strength.summary: 0–1: visibility of ghost copies over the image.

spacing.summary: Distance between the image and each copy, from 10 to 200 pixels.

copies.summary: 2 creates one copy on each side; 3 adds a more distant, fainter copy.

scenes.name: Stone text
scenes.whenToUse: To give a phrase physical weight: stone letters hang briefly, then fall and break the floor.

text.summary: Phrase that becomes stone; automatically wraps to at most three lines.

x.summary: Phrase center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Phrase center while suspended in the air, in pixels.

stoneColor.summary: Stone color, such as light granite gray, sand, or graphite.

scenes.name: Cracked screen
scenes.whenToUse: For a screen-hit joke: glass cracks at the selected point, the image shakes, and the cracks remain.

x.summary: Impact and crack center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Impact point, in pixels.

size.summary: Crack reach from the impact point, in pixels.

scenes.name: Stage spotlight
scenes.whenToUse: For a request for attention or light: the room darkens and a stage spotlight shines on the subject while side beams sweep.

x.summary: Spotlight center over the subject on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Face or chest height where the spotlight has the requested width, in pixels.

width.summary: Spotlight width at y, in pixels.

lightColor.summary: Spotlight color, warm white by default.

beamColor.summary: Color of the two sweeping side beams.

scenes.name: Concert strobe
scenes.whenToUse: For a concert or nightclub joke: the room darkens, a white strobe pulses to the beat, colored beams cross, and fog rises.

x.summary: Beam intersection at the show's center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Height where the beams cross above the head, in pixels.

bpm.summary: Beats per minute; the strobe flashes once per beat.

scenes.name: Explosion
scenes.whenToUse: For an explosion joke: realistic fire, dark smoke, and sparks erupt at x/y, with a white flash and a short shake.

x.summary: Explosion center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Explosion origin, in pixels; the fireball rises about 40% of its size above it.

size.summary: Explosion width, in pixels; the fireball occupies about 45% of it.

scenes.name: Fire
scenes.whenToUse: For a heat or fire joke: realistic flames rise from the lower edge and a warm flicker covers the footage.

x.summary: Horizontal warm-glow center, in pixels; the fire spans the full width.

y.summary: Flame base, in pixels; 1920 places it at the lower edge.

scenes.name: Smoke
scenes.whenToUse: For a disappearing act, mishap, or concealed change: gray smoke rises, covers the screen, and dissipates.

x.summary: Horizontal smoke center, in pixels.

y.summary: Smoke origin at its base, in pixels; 1920 is the lower edge.

strength.summary: 0–1: smoke coverage; one almost hides the underlying video.

scenes.name: Shattered glass
scenes.whenToUse: For a broken-screen joke: glass cracks at x/y and the shards fly and fall, with a short flash and shake.

x.summary: Glass-break center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Glass-break point, in pixels.

size.summary: Glass width, in pixels; cracks cover most of it. A width of 1080–1600 covers the screen.

scenes.name: Neon quote
scenes.whenToUse: For a strong headline: text blocks alternate weights and the starred keyword glows in the corner-light color.

text.summary: Phrase; *asterisks* highlight a keyword in the light color; | optionally separates blocks.

lightColor.summary: "green", "amber", or "red" selects the light and keyword color.

scenes.name: Neon good bad
scenes.whenToUse: To challenge apparently good advice: a green card is struck by a light streak, breaks apart, turns red, and reveals a verdict.

phrase.summary: Green-card phrase representing the advice being challenged.

verdict.summary: Large red verdict shown when the card breaks.

icon.summary: "camera", "play", "check", or "none" selects the icon above the phrase.

scenes.name: Glass chart
scenes.whenToUse: When a metric rises or falls: a white curve draws progressively while its marker and counter move to the final value.

title.summary: Chart label at the top of the card.

direction.summary: "falling" or "rising" sets curve shape and final color: red for falling, green for rising.

suffix.summary: Suffix after the number, such as %, thousand, or x; empty omits it.

scenes.name: Stuck progress bar
scenes.whenToUse: To show something that never quite finishes: a progress bar stops near completion, locks, and reveals an emphatic phrase.

stopAt.summary: Progress value where the bar stops, from 5 to 99.9.

phrase.summary: Emphatic phrase revealed in red below.

scenes.name: Attempt counter
scenes.whenToUse: When success follows repeated attempts: failed attempts receive red crosses and strikes; the successful attempt lights up green.

items.summary: Two to five attempts separated by |.

correct.summary: Successful attempt number; other attempts get crosses. Zero means none succeeded.

scenes.name: Glass list
scenes.whenToUse: When listing completed work or benefits: dim items light up one by one with green checks on a glass card.

title.summary: Label at the top of the card.

items.default: best moments|natural speech rhythm|captions that matter
items.summary: Two to five items separated by |.

scenes.name: Object card
scenes.whenToUse: When introducing an object with numeric facts: a rotating 3D object appears with a 2×2 fact card. Change the video src to a bundled object file; the renderer reads that HTML resource directly.

x.summary: Object center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Object center, in pixels; the title is 273 pixels above and the fact card extends 221 pixels below.

card.default: Temperature|5,500 °C|Age|4.6 billion years|Diameter|1.39 million km|Core|15 million °C
card.summary: Up to four label|value pairs separated by |, two per side; numbers are larger than units.

color.summary: Accent color for the title dot, fact-card line, and object glow.

scenes.name: House construction
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining a build or staged process: a 3D house assembles while step labels light up. Playback runs once at 1.2×, completing in 2.4 seconds; allow at least 3.5 seconds for the badge to follow completion.

x.summary: House center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Vertical reference; labels begin 238 pixels above and the house sits below them.

steps.summary: Two to six top labels separated by |, lit in construction order.

badge.summary: Badge text shown after house construction finishes.

color.summary: Accent color for active step labels and the badge.

scenes.name: Brazil map
scenes.whenToUse: When discussing reach or locations in Brazil: an angled map lights states individually, by region, or in a chosen set, while a counter animates above.

x.summary: Map center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Vertical reference; the title and number begin 240 pixels above and the map sits below them.

states.summary: "all" lights regions in their own colors; otherwise use comma-separated state codes or regions, such as "SP,RJ,MG" or "South,Southeast", in the selected color.

number.summary: Large 96-pixel top-pill value; a numeric value counts from zero as states light up. Text may include a currency or unit, such as "R$ 48,900" or "27 states".

scenes.name: Solar system
scenes.whenToUse: When introducing the universe, a central idea, or orbital relationships: four planets orbit a 3D Sun, passing behind and in front of it.

x.summary: Sun center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Sun center, in pixels; the title is 283 pixels above it.

color.summary: Accent color for the title dot and glow around the Sun.

scenes.name: Video gallery
scenes.whenToUse: When showcasing video work: six portrait cards fan out in 3D and one moves forward. Replace placeholder gradients with muted video elements; set data-start, data-duration, and the correct src. Optional views count below.

x.summary: Gallery center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Cards center, in pixels; title is 283×size above and view count is 240×size below.

size.summary: Gallery scale from 0.5 to 1; for a high face, reduce to about 0.6 and move y to about 420 until it clears the eyes.

title.summary: Top-pill text; an empty string hides the pill.

views.summary: Actual view count of the front video, such as "1.2 million" or "48 thousand"; counts up from zero. Empty hides the pill. Do not invent figures.

color.summary: Accent color for the title dot, play triangle, and eye icon.

scenes.name: Notes interface
scenes.whenToUse: When listing requirements, steps, or tasks: a title types in and each item gains a check in sequence.

title.summary: Note title, typed letter by letter.

items.default: Know your message|Record your idea|Describe the finished video
items.summary: Two to five checklist items separated by |.

scenes.name: AI chat interface
scenes.whenToUse: When showing a request to AI: the request types in, sends, waits, and receives a reply with a finished video.

aiName.summary: AI name at the top of the conversation.

request.summary: Request typed into the box and sent.

scenes.name: Search interface
scenes.whenToUse: When inviting a search or introducing a product: the query types in and a leading result appears.

term.summary: Query typed into the search box.

resultTitle.summary: Large title of the first result.

description.default: and compare a recording before and after editing

scenes.name: Camera interface
scenes.whenToUse: When discussing filming or appearing on camera: the footage becomes a camera viewfinder and a phrase appears word by word.

text.summary: Large viewfinder phrase revealed word by word, below the chin or above the head to avoid the face.

startTime.summary: Initial recording counter time in mm:ss.

y.summary: Phrase center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; empty places it below the measured chin.

size.summary: Maximum font size from 60 to 140 pixels; shrinks automatically to fit three lines.

scenes.name: Command bar
scenes.whenToUse: When showing a computer or AI command: the command types in, Enter submits it, and stages receive checks one by one.

command.default: edit video with captions and zoom

steps.summary: Two to five checked stages separated by |.

background.summary: "dark" or "light" selects the bar and background color.

scenes.name: Receipt
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining cost and elapsed time: the cost card counts up, slides aside, and gives way to a time card.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Card center above the head, in pixels.

value.summary: Value; numeric content counts up from zero.

time.summary: Time value; numeric content counts up from zero.

scenes.name: Completed checklist
scenes.whenToUse: When listing tasks that are no longer necessary: each item appears and is crossed out.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Card top above the head, in pixels.

items.summary: Two to five vertically arranged items separated by |.

title.summary: Title above the list; empty hides it.

scenes.name: Crossed out quote
scenes.whenToUse: When comparing an old recurring cost with a new price.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Open-card center above the head, in pixels.

label.summary: Description of the old expensive option.

oldValue.summary: Old value, crossed out in red.

newValue.summary: New value; numeric content counts up from zero.

scenes.name: Progress meter
scenes.whenToUse: When describing a low or high cost, effort, or risk: a gauge indicates the level.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Card center above the head, in pixels.

level.summary: Needle stopping position from zero, green, to one, red.

color.summary: Label color once the needle stops.

scenes.name: Time counter
scenes.whenToUse: When stating how long a task takes: a counter reaches the chosen time and unit.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Card center above the head, in pixels.

end.summary: Stopwatch target value, counted from zero.

scenes.name: Editing behind scenes
scenes.whenToUse: When showing editing in progress: an editor panel displays footage, waveform, captions, a moving playhead, and successive cuts.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Panel top above the head, in pixels; panel height is 400 pixels.

cuts.summary: Number of cuts, from one to twenty; the counter ends at this value.

color.summary: Accent color for the playhead, elapsed waveform, and counter.

scenes.name: Waveform cuts
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining removed pauses: red waveform gaps disappear one by one, the waveform joins, and the duration decreases.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Card top above the head, in pixels; card height is 378 pixels.

pauses.summary: Number of removed pauses, from one to twelve.

beforeTime.summary: Duration before cuts in m:ss; the counter descends to the after value.

scenes.name: Dentist brushing
scenes.whenToUse: When correcting brushing technique: hard brushing marks the tooth red, the wrong title is crossed out, and a soft brush gently cleans a protected tooth.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; panel size is 860×430.

y.summary: Panel top, in pixels; default 230 places the bottom at y=660, above the eyes.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.5 to 1.1, anchored at the top; automatically shrinks to clear high eyebrows.

wrongTitle.summary: Incorrect-technique title; *asterisks* mark large red text that is crossed out.

correctTitle.summary: Correct-technique title; *asterisks* mark large accent-colored text.

color.summary: Correct-technique accent color for the word, check, and protective tooth glow.

switchAt.summary: Spoken word where the correct title appears, such as "soft", or a scene time in seconds; empty uses the midpoint.

scenes.name: Muscle recovery
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining muscle recovery: training contracts the muscle; sleep, protein, and rest then send energy into it and it grows.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; panel size is 860×430.

y.summary: Panel top, in pixels; default 230 places the bottom at y=660, above the eyes.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.5 to 1.1, anchored at the top; automatically shrinks to clear high eyebrows.

title1.summary: Training title, at most two lines; *asterisks* mark accent-colored text.

recoveryItems.summary: One to four recovery items separated by |; icons are moon, plate, battery, and heart.

scenes.name: Consumer rights
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining retained and lost rights: retained items gain checks while excluded items are crossed out and move away. Verify the applicable jurisdiction and facts.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Panel top above the head, in pixels.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.7 to 1.1, anchored at the top.

title.summary: Question at the top of the panel.

stay.summary: One to three retained items separated by |; each receives a check.

leave.summary: One to three excluded items separated by |; each is crossed out.

scenes.name: Nutrition oranges
scenes.whenToUse: When comparing whole fruit with juice: oranges are squeezed into one glass, sugar remains in the juice, and fiber moves out, with labels.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; panel size is 860×430.

y.summary: Panel top, in pixels; default 230 places the bottom at y=660, above the eyes.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.5 to 1.1, anchored at the top; automatically shrinks to clear high eyebrows.

number.summary: Number of oranges squeezed into the glass, from one to six; the count appears in the title.

title.summary: Title shown when oranges become juice; *asterisks* mark large orange text.

juiceLabel.summary: Label for what stays in the glass.

fiberLabel.summary: Label for what is left out.

scenes.name: Architect room
scenes.whenToUse: When explaining a small-room design: window light reflects from a mirror, then a floor-to-ceiling curtain demonstrates height.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; panel size is 860×430.

y.summary: Panel top, in pixels; default 230 places the bottom at y=660, above the eyes.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.5 to 1.1, anchored at the top; automatically shrinks to clear high eyebrows.

tip1.summary: First tip, shown when light hits the mirror.

tip2.summary: Second tip, shown when the curtain reaches the ceiling.

scenes.name: Year hook
scenes.whenToUse: For an opening year or number hook: large digits flip over a dark chart panel and a pill badge emphasizes the message.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Panel top above the head, in pixels.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.7 to 1.1, anchored at the top.

number.summary: Large year or number; digits spin until they settle.

label.summary: Small upper label inside the dotted pill.

badge.summary: Word inside the pill underlining the number; empty keeps only the underline.

color.summary: Accent color for number depth, dot, chart, and pill.

scenes.name: Profession cards
scenes.whenToUse: When presenting several professions or niches: stacked cards fan out with an occupation icon on each.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Panel top above the head, in pixels.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.7 to 1.1, anchored at the top.

title.summary: Playfair italic title at the top; empty hides it.

items.summary: Three to six professions separated by |; known names select icons and colors, unknown names use a briefcase.

color.summary: Accent color for the title line and unknown-profession card.

scenes.name: Comment call to action
scenes.whenToUse: At the closing call to action: a comment box appears, a keyword types in, and a finger taps Send.

x.summary: Panel center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

y.summary: Panel top above the head, in pixels.

size.summary: Panel scale from 0.7 to 1.1, anchored at the top.

label.summary: Playfair italic heading above the box; empty hides it.

word.summary: Word typed into the box; its final word uses the accent color.

accent.summary: Accent color for the last word, Send button, and tap.

scenes.name: Text karaoke
scenes.whenToUse: For standard short-video captions: white words remain visible while the current spoken word turns yellow and bounces.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

accent.summary: Color of the word currently being spoken.

scenes.name: Text pop
scenes.whenToUse: For a hook or emphatic reversal: one or two large words pop on their spoken timing; the last word is highlighted.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

maxWords.summary: Words per caption group; one or two gives greater emphasis.

color.summary: Text color; dark text receives a white outline.

accent.summary: Color of the last word in each phrase.

scenes.name: Text chromatic
scenes.whenToUse: For energetic technology, AI, or editing captions with a chromatic glitch look.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

spacing.summary: Distance of cyan and magenta copies from the resting word, in pixels.

scenes.name: Text rising glow
scenes.whenToUse: For flowing captions: the current word rises from behind a line with a yellow glow, then turns white.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

glow.summary: Halo strength from zero, none, to one, bright.

scenes.name: Text red word
scenes.whenToUse: For a warning, promise, or strong claim: dim words turn red as spoken and remain lit until the next caption group.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

accent.summary: Word color after it has been spoken.

disabled.summary: 0–1: opacity of words not yet spoken.

scenes.name: Text italic
scenes.whenToUse: For sports, action, challenges, or results: italic captions emphasize the longest word in each group.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

accent.summary: Color of the longest word in each caption group.

scenes.name: Text translucent box
scenes.whenToUse: For tutorials or busy backgrounds: a subtle dark translucent pill contains the phrase, with a brighter current word.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

scenes.name: Text glowing outline
scenes.whenToUse: For conversational tips, routines, or behind-the-scenes footage with a delicate glowing outline.

y.summary: Caption center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

color.summary: Text color; insufficient outline contrast falls back to white or near-black.

scenes.name: Text typewriter
scenes.whenToUse: For commands, code, or AI tutorials: letters type into a dark strip with a moving block cursor that blinks during pauses.

y.summary: Strip center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Font size, in pixels.

color.summary: Text color; dark text switches the strip to a light color.

scenes.name: Text bold title
scenes.whenToUse: For an opening headline: short black text appears on colored strips, one strip per line near the top.

text.summary: Title; | forces a new strip and line, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Block center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit the line.

textColor.summary: Text color; insufficient strip contrast falls back to black or white.

scenes.name: Text two line title
scenes.whenToUse: For a classic short-video hook: a small white lead-in sits above a large accent-colored second line.

line1.summary: Small upper line, white and preserving the supplied case.

line2.summary: Large lower line, uppercase and accent-colored; long text wraps automatically.

y.summary: Block center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum large-font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

accent.summary: Large-line color; dark text receives a white outline.

scenes.name: Text impact
scenes.whenToUse: For an emphatic number, price, or promise: text jumps up, sharpens, and leaves a large translucent echo. The entrance lasts 0.5 seconds, then holds until the cut.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

scenes.name: Text spring
scenes.whenToUse: For an energetic short callout: text springs from zero, overshoots, and settles. It then holds until the cut.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

color.summary: Text color with a thick black outer outline.

entrance.summary: Spring duration from 0.3 to 1.2 seconds; the curve scales with it, as in CapCut.

scenes.name: Text doodle
scenes.whenToUse: For a callout held for several seconds: letters appear individually and wobble like hand-drawn lettering through four stepped poses.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

color.summary: Text color with a black outer outline.

typing.summary: 1 reveals letters individually over 0.43 seconds, as in CapCut; 0 reveals the whole text.

scenes.name: Text twist
scenes.whenToUse: For a sustained call to action: letters shift and their outlines twist around a wavy baseline in four poses per cycle, faster and stronger than Doodle.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

color.summary: Text color with a black outer outline.

cycle.summary: Loop duration from 0.2 to 2 seconds; poses change every quarter-cycle. At 0.5 seconds, each pose lasts 0.125 seconds.

strength.summary: Twist strength from 0.4 to 2; one matches the reference effect.

scenes.name: Text color glitch
scenes.whenToUse: For a technology headline or launch notice: text appears with a chromatic jolt, holds, then briefly splits red and cyan channels across displaced bands.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Box center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

box.summary: Box color behind text; "none" removes the box and adds a text outline.

cycle.summary: Loop duration from 0.2 to 3 seconds, with five flashes per cycle; 0.5 is nervous and 2.5 is slow.

scenes.name: Text spotlight off
scenes.whenToUse: For an emphatic exit: text flashes on under a moving spotlight; the spotlight closes toward the center and disappears in 0.3 seconds.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

light.summary: Outline, moving spotlight, and bright closing-edge color.

exit.summary: Exit duration from 0.2 to 0.6 seconds; closure is concentrated near the end, as in CapCut.

scenes.name: Text exhale
scenes.whenToUse: For an expiring offer or deadline: text types in, holds, then ripples, flattens, blurs horizontally, and evaporates in a 0.5-second exit.

text.summary: Text; | forces a line break, otherwise wrapping is automatic.

y.summary: Text center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit.

color.summary: Text color with a dark outer outline.

exit.summary: Exit duration from 0.3 to 1 second; evaporation is concentrated in the last third, as in CapCut.

typing.summary: 1 types letters with a cursor at the beginning; 0 reveals the whole text.

scenes.name: Text number badge
scenes.whenToUse: For numbered lists: a top pill holds the current number and item name. Use one copy per item, with adjacent copies meeting at their boundaries. Editor captions remain visible below; do not hide them.

text.summary: Short effect, step, or item name, ideally one to four words.

background.summary: Pill color; text automatically uses black or white for readability.

y.summary: Badge center height on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; above the head by default.

size.summary: Maximum font size, in pixels; shrinks automatically to fit the badge.

For footage, replace the image element with a video retaining its ID and class, and add src, data-start="0", data-duration, data-track-index="2", muted, and playsinline. Keep portrait cards beside or below the face; the default 16:9 card sits above it.

height.summary: Card height, in pixels; default aspect ratio is 16:9 and the image fills it with cropping.

radius.summary: Corner radius, in pixels; zero gives square corners.

image.summary: Image filename in the package image folder.

Set image to a file in the image folder. For footage, replace the image element with a video retaining its ID and class, and add src, data-start="0", data-duration, data-track-index="2", muted, and playsinline. scenes.name: Entrance side zoom
scenes.whenToUse: When an image enters from the side and recedes: a mirrored edge accompanies a blurred half-screen slide, followed by gradual shrinking and a faster final shrink to about 0.8×. The side parameter selects direction. Set image to a file in the image folder. For footage, replace the image element with a video retaining its ID and class, and add src, data-start="0", data-duration, data-track-index="2", muted, and playsinline. Keep portrait cards beside or below the face; the default 16:9 card sits above it.

scenes.name: Entrance click open
scenes.whenToUse: When opening a dashboard, link, or result: an image rises at 44% scale, a cursor clicks it, and it expands with an elastic shake and brief blur. It holds until the cut. The 1.3-second entrance compresses below 2.4 seconds to occupy 55% of the scene; sound timing must compress with it. Set image to a file in the image folder. For footage, replace the image element with a video retaining its ID and class, and add src, data-start="0", data-duration, data-track-index="2", muted, and playsinline. Keep portrait cards beside or below the face; the default 16:9 card sits above it.

x.summary: Card center on the 1080×1920 canvas, in pixels; the cursor clicks here.

y.summary: Card center, in pixels; default upper band spans y=232–660, above the eyes.

width.summary: Card width, in pixels; the cursor scales with it.

height.summary: Card height, in pixels; default aspect ratio is 16:9 and the image fills it with cropping.

radius.summary: Final corner radius, in pixels; zero gives square corners, as in CapCut.

image.summary: Image filename in the package image folder.

scenes.name: Entrance before after curtain
scenes.whenToUse: For before/after proof: original footage covers the screen with a recording label, then a bright handled curtain sweeps across, briefly reverses, and reveals the edited footage beneath. The sweep starts after 1 second (earlier below 2.5 seconds) and takes about 1.8 seconds. Match the original clip to the spoken content; remove its CSS filter to retain original color. Set image to a file in the image folder. For footage, replace the image element with a video retaining its ID and class, and add src, data-start="0", data-duration, data-track-index="2", muted, and playsinline. Keep portrait cards beside or below the face; the default 16:9 card sits above it.

x.summary: Handle center for upward sweeps, in pixels; labels use whichever side has room.

y.summary: Handle and label height for horizontal sweeps, in pixels; auto places them just below editor captions, or above low captions.

image.summary: BEFORE image filename in the package image folder; replace img with video for original footage.

beforeLabel.summary: BEFORE-side label, such as original or recorded; empty hides it.

afterLabel.summary: AFTER-side label, such as edited or AI-assisted; empty hides it.

direction.summary: Sweep direction: "left" reveals AFTER from the right, "right" from the left, and "up" from below.
